Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the familial lineage. After correctly identifying that Nakkhatra Mangala was the son of Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana (which makes Voralaksana Busba’s paternal grandfather), the Planner incorrectly jumped one generation and named King Chulalongkorn (Voralaksana’s father) as the paternal grandfather. This confusion between grandfather and great-grandfather led to the wrong final answer.
